# Desain Sampling

## Tingkat Keterisian Sampel
```{r coverage_rate}
n_populasi  <- 127
n_target    <- 55
n_responden <- 57   # sebelum dedup
n_valid     <- 56   # sesudah dedup

coverage_rate <- round(n_valid / n_populasi * 100, 1)

kable(data.frame(
  Keterangan = c("Populasi", "Target Sampel Minimum", "Responden Masuk",
                 "Duplikat Dihapus", "Responden Valid"),
  Nilai = c(n_populasi, n_target, n_responden, n_responden - n_valid, n_valid)
), caption = "Ringkasan Pengumpulan Data")

cat("Coverage rate:", coverage_rate, "% dari populasi\n")
cat("Target n tercapai:", ifelse(n_valid >= n_target, "Ya", "Belum"), "\n")
```

# Praproses Data

## Impor & Verifikasi Kolom
```{r import_data}
data_raw <- read_csv("DataBefore_6.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
cat("Dimensi awal:", nrow(data_raw), "baris x", ncol(data_raw), "kolom\n")
```

```{r cek_kolom}
kable(data.frame(Index = seq_along(names(data_raw)), Kolom = names(data_raw)),
      caption = "Cek index kolom sebelum subsetting")
```

```{r cek_grup_kolom}
cat("Kolom 5-14 (harus item IK):\n"); print(names(data_raw)[5:14])
cat("\nKolom 15-23 (harus item PM):\n"); print(names(data_raw)[15:23])
cat("\nKolom 24-31 (harus item PB):\n"); print(names(data_raw)[24:31])
cat("\nKolom 32-39 (harus item KL):\n"); print(names(data_raw)[32:39])
```

Kalau salah satu output di atas tidak cocok dengan nama item yang diharapkan, ganti angka index-nya — jangan lanjut dulu.

## Hapus Duplikat & Skor Komposit
```{r dedup_skor}
data <- data_raw %>% distinct(Nama, .keep_all = TRUE)
cat("Setelah hapus duplikat:", nrow(data), "dari", nrow(data_raw), "responden\n")

data <- data %>%
  mutate(IK = rowMeans(across(5:14),  na.rm = TRUE),
         PM = rowMeans(across(15:23), na.rm = TRUE),
         PB = rowMeans(across(24:31), na.rm = TRUE),
         KL = rowMeans(across(32:39), na.rm = TRUE))
```
Skor komposit = rata-rata semua item dalam satu konstruk. Misalnya IK = rata-rata 10 item soal "kebut semalam".

## Missing Values
```{r missing_values}
mv <- data.frame(Variabel = names(data), Missing = colSums(is.na(data)),
                  Persen = round(colSums(is.na(data)) / nrow(data) * 100, 2))
kable(mv %>% filter(Variabel %in% c("IK","PM","PB","KL","Kelas Besar",
      "Rata-rata jam tidur saat minggu ujian")), caption = "Missing — Variabel Utama")
```

## Coding Ordinal Jam Tidur
```{r coding_tidur}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(Tidur_Kode = case_when(
    `Rata-rata jam tidur saat minggu ujian` == "7 - 8 jam"   ~ 5,
    `Rata-rata jam tidur saat minggu ujian` == "5 - 6 jam"   ~ 4,
    `Rata-rata jam tidur saat minggu ujian` == "3 - 4 jam"   ~ 3,
    `Rata-rata jam tidur saat minggu ujian` == "1 - 2 jam"   ~ 2,
    `Rata-rata jam tidur saat minggu ujian` == "Tidak tidur" ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_))

kable(as.data.frame(table(data$`Rata-rata jam tidur saat minggu ujian`, data$Tidur_Kode)),
      col.names = c("Kategori","Kode","Frekuensi"))
```

`Tidur_Kode` itu ordinal (1-5 = urutan kategori, bukan jarak yang sama). Karena itu, korelasi yang melibatkan variabel ini nanti dihitung dengan Spearman, bukan Pearson.

## Export Data Bersih
```{r export_csv}
data_export <- data %>%
  select(Nama, `Kelas Besar`, `Rata-rata jam tidur saat minggu ujian`,
         Tidur_Kode, IK, PM, PB, KL, everything(), -any_of("Timestamp"))
write_csv(data_export, "DataAfter_6.csv")
cat("Disimpan:", nrow(data_export), "baris x", ncol(data_export), "kolom\n")
```

`-any_of("Timestamp")` dipakai supaya kalau kolom `Timestamp` tidak ada (nama beda/tidak ada), kode tetap jalan tanpa error.

# Statistik Deskriptif

```{r summary_stats_new}
construct_summary <- data.frame(
  Variabel = c("IK","PM","PB","KL"),
  Mean = round(c(mean(data$IK), mean(data$PM), mean(data$PB), mean(data$KL)),3),
  SD = round(c(sd(data$IK), sd(data$PM), sd(data$PB), sd(data$KL)),3),
  Min = round(c(min(data$IK), min(data$PM), min(data$PB), min(data$KL)),3),
  Max = round(c(max(data$IK), max(data$PM), max(data$PB), max(data$KL)),3)
)
kable(construct_summary, caption = "Statistik Deskriptif Variabel Penelitian")

sleep_table <- data %>%
  count(`Rata-rata jam tidur saat minggu ujian`) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
kable(sleep_table, col.names = c("Jam Tidur", "Frekuensi"), caption = "Distribusi Jam Tidur Responden")
```

Mean di sekitar 3 = netral. Di atas 3 berarti cenderung setuju dengan konstruk tersebut, di bawah 3 cenderung tidak setuju.

## Visualisasi: Rata-rata per Item

```{r helper_item_plot}
plot_items <- function(cols, labels, judul, warna_rendah, warna_tinggi) {
  df <- data.frame(Label = labels, Mean = colMeans(data[, cols], na.rm = TRUE))
  ggplot(df, aes(reorder(Label, Mean), Mean, fill = Mean)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65) + geom_text(aes(label = round(Mean,2)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 3, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
    coord_flip() + scale_fill_gradient(low = warna_rendah, high = warna_tinggi) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,5.6)) +
    labs(title = judul, x = NULL, y = "Mean (1-5)") + theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")
}
```

# Uji Reliabilitas (Cronbach's Alpha)
Alpha mengukur konsistensi internal item dalam satu konstruk. Patokan umum: alpha ≥ 0.70 = reliabel.
```{r reliabilitas_dan_validitas}
a_ik <- psych::alpha(data[,5:14]);  a_pm <- psych::alpha(data[,15:23])
a_pb <- psych::alpha(data[,24:31]); a_kl <- psych::alpha(data[,32:39])

alpha_vals <- c(a_ik$total$raw_alpha, a_pm$total$raw_alpha, a_pb$total$raw_alpha, a_kl$total$raw_alpha)

check_citc <- function(alpha_obj, nama) {
  citc <- round(alpha_obj$item.stats$r.drop, 3)
  data.frame(Konstruk = nama, Item = rownames(alpha_obj$item.stats), CITC = citc,
             Status = ifelse(citc < 0.30, "Lemah", "OK"))
}
citc_all <- rbind(check_citc(a_ik,"IK"), check_citc(a_pm,"PM"),
                   check_citc(a_pb,"PB"), check_citc(a_kl,"KL"))

validity_summary <- citc_all %>%
  group_by(Konstruk) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Item = n(),
    Item_Valid = sum(CITC >= 0.30),
    Item_Tidak_Valid = sum(CITC < 0.30)
  )

kable(validity_summary, caption = "Summary of Validity Test")

kable(data.frame(Konstruk = c("IK","PM","PB","KL"), Alpha = round(alpha_vals,3),
                  Status = ifelse(alpha_vals >= 0.70, "Reliabel", "Perlu Ditinjau")),
      caption = "Cronbach's Alpha per Konstruk")
```

## Cek Item Lemah (CITC) per Konstruk
Melihat langsung item-total correlation (CITC) tiap konstruk, dengan item yang memilikin CITC < 0.30 dianggap lemah.

```{r citc_check}
kable(citc_all, caption = "Item-Total Correlation — Semua Konstruk")
```

```{r citc_text}
lemah_pb <- citc_all %>% filter(Konstruk == "PB", Status == "Lemah") %>% pull(Item)
```

Item PB dengan CITC di bawah 0.30: **`r if(length(lemah_pb)==0) "tidak ada" else paste(lemah_pb, collapse=", ")`**. Item ini (kalau ada) jadi kandidat untuk direvisi atau dikeluarkan dari konstruk PB pada survei berikutnya.

# Analisis Korelasi
Skor komposit (IK, PM, PB, KL) adalah rata-rata item Likert, tapi lazim diperlakukan sebagai kuasi-kontinu sehingga Pearson umum dipakai. `Tidur_Kode` murni ordinal kategori (bukan rata-rata banyak item), jadi untuk variabel ini Spearman lebih tepat. 
```{r cor_matrix}
vars_cor <- c("IK","PM","PB","KL","Tidur_Kode")
cor_p <- cor(data[, vars_cor], method = "pearson",  use = "complete.obs")
cor_s <- cor(data[, vars_cor], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

kable(round(cor_p, 3), caption = "Korelasi Pearson")
kable(round(cor_s, 3), caption = "Korelasi Spearman (pembanding, karena dasar data ordinal)")
```

```{r corrplot, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
corrplot(cor_p, method = "color", type = "upper", addCoef.col = "black",
         tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45, col = colorRampPalette(c("red","white","blue"))(200),
         title = "Matriks Korelasi (Pearson)", mar = c(0,0,1.5,0))
```

```{r cor_tests}
cor_pairs <- list(
  list(x="IK", y="PM", m="pearson"), list(x="IK", y="PB", m="pearson"),
  list(x="IK", y="KL", m="pearson"), list(x="KL", y="PM", m="pearson"),
  list(x="PB", y="PM", m="pearson"), list(x="Tidur_Kode", y="IK", m="spearman")
)

cor_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cor_pairs, function(p) {
  t <- cor.test(data[[p$x]], data[[p$y]], method = p$m)
  data.frame(Pasangan = paste(p$x,"vs",p$y), Metode = p$m,
             r = round(unname(t$estimate), 3), p_value = round(t$p.value, 4),
             Signifikan = ifelse(t$p.value < 0.05, "Ya *", "Tidak"))
}))
kable(cor_summary, caption = "Ringkasan Uji Korelasi")
```

r mendekati 0 = nyaris tidak ada hubungan linear; tanda + / - menunjukkan arah; p < 0.05 berarti hubungan itu tidak terjadi karena kebetulan.

# Uji Normalitas
Shapiro-Wilk paling akurat untuk n < 50. Sampel ini n = 56, jadi sedikit di luar rentang ideal — hasilnya tetap informatif, tapi sebaiknya dicek juga lewat Q-Q plot di bagian diagnostic plot regresi nanti, bukan cuma p-value-nya.

```{r normalitas}
sw <- lapply(data[, c("IK","PM","PB","KL")], shapiro.test)
norm_df <- data.frame(Variabel = c("IK","PM","PB","KL"),
                       W = round(sapply(sw, function(x) x$statistic), 4),
                       p_value = round(sapply(sw, function(x) x$p.value), 4))
norm_df$Normal <- ifelse(norm_df$p_value > 0.05, "Ya", "Tidak")
kable(norm_df, caption = "Shapiro-Wilk")
```

# Regresi Linear

## Model 1: PM ~ IK
```{r model1}
model1 <- lm(PM ~ IK, data = data)

coef1 <- summary(model1)$coefficients
simple_reg <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(coef1),
  Estimate = round(coef1[,1],4),
  Std_Error = round(coef1[,2],4),
  t_Value = round(coef1[,3],4),
  P_Value = round(coef1[,4],4)
)
kable(simple_reg, caption = "Simple Linear Regression Result")
```

### Simple Linear Regression

Untuk menguji pengaruh langsung Intensitas Kebut Semalam terhadap Pemahaman Materi, dilakukan regresi linear sederhana.

**Model:**
$$PM = \beta_0 + \beta_1 IK + \varepsilon$$

```{r simple_reg_table, echo=FALSE}
simple_reg_img <- data.frame(
  Variabel = c("Intercept", "IK"),
  Koefisien = round(coef1[, 1], 4),
  `p-value` = round(coef1[, 4], 4),
  check.names = FALSE
)

kable(simple_reg_img, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Hasil Regresi Linear Sederhana")
```

Hasil regresi menunjukkan bahwa Intensitas Kebut Semalam `r ifelse(summary(model1)$coefficients[2,4] < 0.05, "memiliki", "tidak memiliki")` pengaruh signifikan terhadap Pemahaman Materi.

```{r viz_model1, fig.height=4.5}
ggplot(data, aes(IK, PM)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.55, color = "blue", size = 2.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", fill = "pink") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:5, limits = c(1.5,5.2)) +
  labs(title = "Regresi Sederhana: IK -> PM",
       subtitle = paste0("r=", round(cor(data$IK,data$PM),3),
                          " | R²=", round(summary(model1)$r.squared,4),
                          " | p=", round(summary(model1)$coefficients[2,4],4)),
       x = "IK", y = "PM") + theme_minimal()
```

Kalau garis tren hampir flat dan p > 0.05, artinya IK sendirian (tanpa kontrol variabel lain) tidak cukup untuk memprediksi PM.

## Model 2: PM ~ IK + PB + KL
```{r model2}
model2 <- lm(PM ~ IK + PB + KL, data = data)

coef2 <- summary(model2)$coefficients
multiple_reg <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(coef2),
  Estimate = round(coef2[,1],4),
  Std_Error = round(coef2[,2],4),
  t_Value = round(coef2[,3],4),
  P_Value = round(coef2[,4],4)
)
kable(multiple_reg, caption = "Multiple Regression Result")
```

```{r model2_coef}
coef_table <- summary(model2)$coefficients

hypothesis_table <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(coef_table)[-1],
  Estimate = round(coef_table[-1,1], 4),
  P_Value = round(coef_table[-1,4], 4)
)

hypothesis_table$Decision <- ifelse(
  hypothesis_table$P_Value < 0.05,
  "Accepted",
  "Rejected"
)

kable(hypothesis_table, caption = "Hypothesis Testing Result")

model_summary <- summary(model2)
f_stat <- model_summary$fstatistic
p_val_f <- pf(f_stat[1], f_stat[2], f_stat[3], lower.tail = FALSE)

f_test_df <- data.frame(
  F_Statistic = round(f_stat[1], 3),
  DF1 = f_stat[2],
  DF2 = f_stat[3],
  P_Value = round(p_val_f, 4)
)

kable(f_test_df, caption = "Uji Kelayakan Model (F-Test / ANOVA)")
```

## Uji Asumsi
```{r uji_asumsi}
vif_vals <- vif(model2)
kable(data.frame(Variabel = names(vif_vals), VIF = round(vif_vals,3),
                  Status = ifelse(vif_vals < 5, "OK", "Perlu Perhatian")),
      caption = "Multikolinearitas (VIF)")

bp <- bptest(model2); sw_res <- shapiro.test(residuals(model2))
kable(data.frame(Uji = c("Breusch-Pagan","Shapiro-Wilk Residual"),
                  Statistik = round(c(bp$statistic, sw_res$statistic), 4),
                  p_value = round(c(bp$p.value, sw_res$p.value), 4),
                  Kesimpulan = c(ifelse(bp$p.value>0.05,"Tidak ada heteroskedastisitas","Ada heteroskedastisitas"),
                                 ifelse(sw_res$p.value>0.05,"Residual normal","Residual tidak normal"))))
```

```{r diagnostic_plots, fig.height=7}
par(mfrow = c(2,2)); plot(model2); par(mfrow = c(1,1))
```

Plot kiri-atas (Residuals vs Fitted) untuk cek pola non-linear; kanan-atas (Q-Q) untuk cek normalitas residual secara visual, menjadi pelengkap Shapiro-Wilk di atas, terutama karena n kita borderline.

---

# Mediasi: KL sebagai Mediator (IK -> KL -> PM)

Desain kuesioner menempatkan KL (kelelahan) sebagai mediator/pengganggu antara IK dan PM. Dicek pakai langkah Baron & Kenny:
```{r mediasi}
model_a <- lm(KL ~ IK, data = data)         # Langkah 2: IK -> KL
model_b <- lm(PM ~ IK + KL, data = data)    # Langkah 3 & 4: KL & IK -> PM (kontrol satu sama lain)

med_df <- data.frame(
  Langkah = c("1. IK -> PM (tanpa kontrol)", "2. IK -> KL", "3. KL -> PM (kontrol IK)", "4. IK -> PM (kontrol KL)"),
  Koefisien = round(c(coef(model1)["IK"], coef(model_a)["IK"], coef(model_b)["KL"], coef(model_b)["IK"]), 4),
  p_value = round(c(summary(model1)$coefficients["IK","Pr(>|t|)"],
                     summary(model_a)$coefficients["IK","Pr(>|t|)"],
                     summary(model_b)$coefficients["KL","Pr(>|t|)"],
                     summary(model_b)$coefficients["IK","Pr(>|t|)"]), 4))
kable(med_df, caption = "Langkah Baron & Kenny")
```

```{r mediasi_text}
step1_sig <- summary(model1)$coefficients["IK","Pr(>|t|)"] < 0.05
step2_sig <- summary(model_a)$coefficients["IK","Pr(>|t|)"] < 0.05
step3_sig <- summary(model_b)$coefficients["KL","Pr(>|t|)"] < 0.05
```

Syarat minimal mediasi Baron & Kenny: Langkah 1 harus signifikan (IK harus benar-benar memprediksi PM sebelum KL bisa dibilang "menjelaskan" hubungan). 
Di sini Langkah 1 **`r if(step1_sig) "signifikan" else "tidak signifikan"`**, sehingga kesimpulannya:
**`r if(!step1_sig) "tidak ada efek mediasi yang bisa diuji — karena tidak ada hubungan awal IK->PM yang perlu dijelaskan oleh KL" else if(step2_sig & step3_sig) "ada indikasi mediasi" else "mediasi tidak terbukti kuat"`**.

# Perbandingan Kelas LA09 vs LB09
```{r class_comparison}
class_agg <- data %>% group_by(`Kelas Besar`) %>%
  summarise(n=n(), IK=round(mean(IK),3), PM=round(mean(PM),3), PB=round(mean(PB),3), KL=round(mean(KL),3))
kable(class_agg, caption = "Rata-rata per Kelas")
```

```{r ttest}
tt <- lapply(c("IK","PM","PB","KL"), function(v) t.test(data[[v]] ~ data$`Kelas Besar`))
ttest_df <- data.frame(Variabel = c("IK","PM","PB","KL"),
                        t = round(sapply(tt, function(x) x$statistic), 3),
                        p_value = round(sapply(tt, function(x) x$p.value), 4))
ttest_df$Signifikan <- ifelse(ttest_df$p_value < 0.05, "Ya *", "Tidak")
kable(ttest_df, caption = "t-test: LA09 vs LB09")
```

```{r viz_class, fig.height=4.5}
data %>% select(`Kelas Besar`, IK, PM, PB, KL) %>%
  pivot_longer(-`Kelas Besar`, names_to = "Konstruk", values_to = "Skor") %>%
  mutate(Konstruk = factor(Konstruk, levels = c("IK","PM","PB","KL"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Konstruk, Skor, fill = `Kelas Besar`)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 3, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Skor per Konstruk: LA09 vs LB09") + theme_minimal()
```

---

# Kesimpulan
```{r kesimpulan_calc}
r_ik_pm <- round(cor(data$IK,data$PM),3); p_ik_pm <- round(cor.test(data$IK,data$PM)$p.value,4)
r_ik_pb <- round(cor(data$IK,data$PB),3); p_ik_pb <- round(cor.test(data$IK,data$PB)$p.value,4)
r_pb_pm <- round(cor(data$PB,data$PM),3); p_pb_pm <- round(cor.test(data$PB,data$PM)$p.value,4)
r2_m2 <- round(summary(model2)$r.squared,3)
coef_pb_m2 <- round(coef(model2)["PB"],3); p_pb_m2 <- round(summary(model2)$coefficients["PB","Pr(>|t|)"],4)
ttest_max_p <- round(max(ttest_df$p_value),3)
```
```{r}
cat("IK vs PM: r =", r_ik_pm,
    ", p-value =", p_ik_pm, "\n")

cat("IK vs PB: r =", r_ik_pb,
    ", p-value =", p_ik_pb, "\n")

cat("PB vs PM: r =", r_pb_pm,
    ", p-value =", p_pb_pm, "\n")

cat("R-squared Model 2 =", r2_m2, "\n")

cat("Koefisien PB =", coef_pb_m2,
    ", p-value =", p_pb_m2, "\n")

cat("Maximum p-value t-test =", ttest_max_p, "\n")
```

**Temuan Utama:**

1. IK vs PM: r = `r r_ik_pm`, p = `r p_ik_pm` — `r if(p_ik_pm<0.05) "signifikan" else "tidak signifikan"`. Kebut semalam saja tidak terbukti langsung menurunkan/menaikkan pemahaman.
2. IK vs PB: r = `r r_ik_pb`, p = `r p_ik_pb` — `r if(p_ik_pb<0.05) "signifikan" else "tidak signifikan"`.
3. PB vs PM: r = `r r_pb_pm`, p = `r p_pb_pm` — `r if(p_pb_pm<0.05) "signifikan" else "tidak signifikan"`. Pola belajar yang teratur berkaitan dengan pemahaman yang lebih baik.
4. Regresi berganda: PB koefisien = `r coef_pb_m2`, p = `r p_pb_m2`, model menjelaskan `r r2_m2*100`% variasi PM (R² = `r r2_m2`).
5. Perbandingan LA09 vs LB09: p terbesar dari semua konstruk = `r ttest_max_p` — tidak ada perbedaan signifikan antar kelas.
